entries.reason: iOS 6 does not export the name; it is carried with the text the newer release gives it, so that an application that names it loads
entries.effect: the notification name CTServiceRadioAccessTechnologyDidChangeNotification, carried and never posted: nothing of iOS 6 posts it
entries.source: the arm64 shared cache of iOS 12.0, where each constant is a string and its text was read; the header of iOS 16.4 for its type and the release that added it; an iPad 2 running 6.1.3 and the iOS 6.0 emulator, asked with dlsym, which export none of the names
